description: This file is a test suite for the NetworkManager component of a network management software, utilizing Google Test framework. It includes numerous test cases for verifying methods related to network interfaces, IP settings, Wi-Fi operations, WPS, Wi-Fi state, STUN endpoint configuration, and other network functionalities. The tests mock external dependencies and verify expected behavior of the NetworkManager implementation.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from ::testing::Test, sets up mocks, initializes the NetworkManager plugin instance, and provides cleanup. It contains various test cases for methods such as interface management, IP configuration, Wi-Fi operations, and WPS functions within the test suite.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from ::testing::Test, setting up mocks and initializing the NetworkManager plugin instance for the test suite. It provides setup and cleanup functionalities required for unit testing network operations, Wi-Fi signal quality assessments, traceroute, and ping tests.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods

methods.description: Caches IPv4 address information within the plugin.

methods.description: Caches IPv6 address information within the plugin.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQualityDisconnected2
methods.description: Tests the GetWiFiSignalQuality handler, mocking the 'wpa_cli status' command output for a disconnected WLAN interface and verifying the JSON response indicates disconnection.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQualityConnected
methods.description: Mocks 'wpa_cli status' and 'wpa_cli signal_poll' outputs for a connected Wi-Fi network, assessing the handler's ability to accurately parse signal quality metrics and output correct JSON.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQualityConnectedGood
methods.description: Tests signal quality when the RSSI and other metrics indicate a good connection, ensuring correct assessment of signal strength and quality.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQualityConnectedLowBad
methods.description: Simulates a situation where RSSI is missing or the noise level indicates poor quality; the test verifies correct handling of such edge cases.

methods.name: Trace_Success_ipv4
methods.description: Mocks the traceroute command output for IPv4 and checks whether the handler correctly interprets and formats the traceroute results into JSON.

methods.name: Trace_Failed_ipv6
methods.description: Mocks a failure output for IPv6 traceroute command and verifys that the handler returns a JSON response containing the error message in the results.

methods.name: Trace_Success_ipv6
methods.description: Mocks a successful IPv6 traceroute, checking that the handler correctly includes detailed hop information in its JSON response.

methods.name: Ping_Success_ipv4
methods.description: Mocks a successful ping to an IPv4 endpoint, providing typical ping output and verifying the handler computes statistics such as min, max, avg, and packet loss correctly.

methods.name: Ping_Failed_ipv4
methods.description: Mocks a failed ping output (no packets received) for IPv4 and checks that the JSON response correctly indicates 100% packet loss.

methods.name: Ping_success_ipv6
methods.description: Mocks a successful ping response for IPv6, including details like duplicated packets, and checks correct statistical parsing.

methods.name: Ping_Failed_ipv6
methods.description: Mocks a scenario where the ping6 command fails to execute (returns NULL), verifying that the handler responds with minimal info as expected.
